name: @oneuptime/ops-tests
description: Static/structural tests for the repo's ops config: ClickHouse config.d drop-ins, docker-compose mounts, the container agents' collector configs, the backup/restore scripts, and how the Community and Enterprise editions are built and tested. `npm test` needs no services; `npm run validate-collector-configs` additionally needs docker and helm, `npm run lint-app-dockerfile` docker, and `npm run vmware-agent-native-install` docker and network access.
